description: The group approaches Hakugyokurou and witnesses the Saigyou Ayakashi frantically absorbing Spring Energy. Gensokyo's spring is being stolen bit by bit, and everyone feels the pressure.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I've been looking for that woman. If you know who it is, please tell me."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Although not exactly suspicious, she is indeed a very strange woman."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "A space full of eyes? That sounds terrifying..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Is this the kind of person you're looking for?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er tries hard to recall the image Youmu described in his mind.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Your face is so red. Did I accidentally leave something like oleander on your face earlier because I was too nervous?" #Tilting head in thought 🤔 "Well, probably not, I guess?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She hangs the sword back at her waist, pondering.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Yakumo Yukari, that's her name. Your master's good friend, Yuyuko's friend, Yakumo Yukari."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yakumo Yukari... I think I've heard that name in stories from my childhood..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "It gives me the creeps. Usually, at times like this, someone is peeping."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I have a feeling Yakumo Yukari definitely knows something more."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It doesn't matter. The current goal is to make Yuyuko stop collecting Spring Energy."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The Hakurei shrine maiden, why isn't that guy here yet."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It seems we're reaching the end of the journey... everyone."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "If you can't do it, please don't force yourself."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er comments on the Hakurei shrine maiden from the side.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+6d4=2+{1+1+3+3+1+1}(10)=12 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 1

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In Ge Qing's Mind's Eye, at that very moment, there indeed was a sense of being watched.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Can Youmu cook? By the way, what do you all eat here? You're half-living too, right?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "But do people in the Netherworld need to eat?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Actually, I've been wondering about that too."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Speaking of which, the many cherry blossoms here are beautiful, all thanks to the Spring Energy. Yuyuko probably wants the cherry trees to bloom fully in the Netherworld."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "If they bloomed, it would indeed be beautiful, but it would just be a false bloom..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Does a spirit like Lady Yuyuko even need to eat... or something."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Don't think like that. If she eats, it must be because she's hungry."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Have confidence. This journey is for a righteous cause."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: After fighting Yuyuko to your heart's content,

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Next, we'll have to face that... Saigyouji Yuyuko."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Also the bedchamber of the Princess of Spirits.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Yeah, don't be afraid. She might be surprisingly easy to talk to."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "From what she said earlier, her personality seems similar to ours."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sigh... I don't want to fight anymore, it hurts..." #Holding the wound from being bitten by the Devourer earlier

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Lady Yuyuko is a bit stubborn, but she's a good person. Please let me tend to your battle wounds as compensation."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Yuyu says this as the half-ghost behind her flies out with bandages.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Thank you, even though I just did something like that to you..." #flusteredly expressing thanks

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "It can help bandage you up, though it's not much use."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The mochi behind the girl flies over and expertly wraps the two injured parties into mummy-like shapes.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Elusive Devourer of Luo Xueyu]'s 'Existence Record'... updated: [MP]: 10+3=13

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "So beautiful..." #muttering to myself while looking at the place I'm in.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The air floats with a clear, cold fragrance, a complex scent mixing fir, old books, and some unknown spice. Countless pale pink Spring Energy light points, like summoned fireflies, silently converge towards the depths of the courtyard, disappearing behind that dense emerald green.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "But even with so much Spring Energy, it's still so cold."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Just the moment you see that building,

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Sniffing the surrounding scent, walking slowly towards Hakugyokurou. "I never thought I'd come to Hakugyokurou while still alive."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: It is probably what the half-ghost girl mentioned,

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: This space is terrifyingly quiet, with only the flowing light points, as if all sound has been quietly absorbed by the white building and the ink-green vegetation. Walking along the courtyard, countless Spring Energy light points still guide the way ahead.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Will cutting this down restore the Spring Energy?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Right at the center of the vortex, beside the torrent of energy strong enough to tear souls apart, a figure sat peacefully on the thickest horizontal branch

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: It was a young woman with long cherry blossom-colored hair, her strands almost blending with the falling sakura petals around her. She wore an ornate kimono with intricate patterns, and beneath the hem, a pair of pale bare feet dangled leisurely, swaying gently to some silent rhythm.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl was slightly tilting her head up. Her exquisite profile, illuminated by the swirling Spring Energy, appeared somewhat translucent and unreal. Her pink eyes gazed vacantly at the eternally gray sky of the Netherworld, her fingers unconsciously twirling a strand of hair. Her entire being exuded a laziness and boredom utterly at odds with the earth-shattering spectacle before her, as if this act of draining the vitality of all Gensokyo was, to her, nothing more than a boring game to pass the time.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Use ability on self, blending vitality and death energy to become a living-dead state.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Have you come to view the flowers?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We'd like to ask you... to please return this Spring Energy."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Flower viewing isn't fun unless everyone is together."
